info.title: QuayReady engineering contract
info.description: Implemented local synthetic integration lab. Independent branding; no company affiliation, physical departure or customs authorisation. Review-only dispatch requests. See docs/implementation.md.

post.description: 32-byte random login tokens from ignored server configuration map to stable subject/site/roles. Max 5 login attempts per minute per process. Absolute session lifetime 30min; restart logs out. No token in logs.

post.description: Separate server on 127.0.0.1:8081, separate DB. Source site bound to WorkerKey; seed orderref/revision required. 409 PAYLOAD_CONFLICT for changed ID payload; TARGET_SHIPMENT_CONFLICT for another dispatch ID on same shipment. No physical/customs release. Fault injection is process configuration in tests, not a public endpoint.

post.description: Reserves a generation, performs one bounded target GET outside a transaction, audits the result. Never POSTs to target, changes dispatch identity, resets budgets or clears the unresolved barrier without a matching receipt. Concurrent older result is rejected. The single mock target credential is bound to DEMO-ZEE; other-site target investigation is rejected with 403 before HTTP.

200.description: Confirmed receipt or unchanged manual-review uncertainty
